exposure: Ventriculoperitoneal Shunt (VPS) placement with Gastrostomy Tube (GT) placement
Timing of GT placement relative to VPS placement (GT before VPS vs. VPS before GT)
cohort: Newborns who underwent ventriculoperitoneal shunt (VPS) placement during their initial hospitalization.
finding: Concurrent gastrostomy tube placement during the same hospitalization as ventriculoperitoneal shunts increased shunt complications in newborns, and placing the shunt before the gastrostomy tube was associated with fewer complications.
